text:
Mira: heads-up — after the routing-policy rollout at 14:10 UTC p95 in the console for /generate on dedicated-pool-A looks off. p50 steady, p99 jumped ~2.5x. anyone else seeing this?
Kevin: yep, saw the spike around 14:23. p95 went from ~120ms -> ~380ms, p99 220ms -> ~1.1s. sample_count doesn't look wildly different in the top-line card though.
Sara: sample_count actually dropped ~12% for dedicated-pool-A and we see more hits labeled route=fallback-shared. likely fallback to cheaper variant. cold starts + different kernel could explain tail.
Jordan: that matches the routing change — policy now prefers lower-cost variants when quota near limit. fallback variant (model-quant-v2) has higher init latency.
deploy-bot: rollout completed: v2-routing-policy @prod at 2024-10-18T14:10:02Z by Jordan (:party-parrot:)
Kevin: dashboard percentiles alone are dangerous here. if the sample origin shifted from dedicated -> fallback the p95 reflects different distribution, not necessarily regression. can we show sample origin breakdown next to pctl?
Mira: agreed. short-term ask: add a stacked breakdown by route tag for p50/p95/p99 so we can see contribution from fallback. also show sample_count for each percentile.
Sara: +1. UX idea: show a small histogram sparkline or bucket counts under the percentile so engineers can eyeball multimodal distributions.
Jordan: quick PromQL I used to validate: ```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
Kevin: nice. also useful: ```
sum by (route) (rate(request_duration_seconds_count[5m]))
``` to see sample origin.
Mira: filed INF-782 to add "percentile origin" toggle and sample_count badge to the Console percentiles card: https://redwood.company/infra/INF-782
Kevin: UX detail — if sample_count < 200 show an explicit "unstable sample" pill next to pctl. a lot of folks interpret noisy p99 as ground truth.
Sara: for longer term we should: 1) annotate routing-policy rollouts in the console timeline, 2) add gating that prevents policy flips if p95 varies > 2x across primary routes, 3) keep a trace-sample link from pctl to examples.
Jordan: I'll add an alert rule prototype: if increase(p95[15m]) > 2x AND sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_count[5m])) < 1000 then notify #eng-oncall and post console snapshot.
Mira: short-term workaround done: added a derived split in the dashboard that sets include_fallback=false to compare. patch pushed to staging.
Kevin: testing staging now — initial looks good, the p95 delta disappears when excluding fallback.
Sara: will roll this fix to prod then revert routing-policy toggle if we see repeated regressions.
Mira: thanks all. follow-ups: Jordan will draft alert rule, Sara will sketch Console UI change (percentile origin + sample badge), Kevin will monitor for 2 hours after prod patch. I'll update INF-782 with notes. :thumbsup:
